page.layout: One page of text in a single column; at the right edge of each line a printed "«" mark. Page number at top right. Running head at top. Catchword and a signature mark at the foot.

main_text.p: cerone. Lex: Qui in adversa tempestate navim reliquerint, omnia amittunto: eorū navis & onera sunto, qui in navi remanserint. Duo quidam, cum jam in alto navigarent, & eorū alterius navis, alterius onus esset, naufragū quendam natantem, & manus ad se tendentem animadverterunt: misericordia commoti, navim ad eum applicaverunt, hominem ad se sustulerunt. Postea aliquato ipsos quoque tempestas vehementius jactare coepit, usq; adeò ut dominus navis, cum idem gubernator esset, in scapham confugeret, & inde funiculo, qui

page.notes: The printed "«" marks at the right edge of each line are not text and are left out. The "Qui" in the opening line carries a small stroke under it, read as a plain word. Printed line-end hyphens are kept only in "relique-rint", "qui-dam" and "ma-nus"; other words broken across lines without a hyphen are written whole. Ligature "ct" in "iactare" is read as ct. Page number and running head are printed in small capitals and read from the scan.
